verdict.rationale: Stagehand's own v3 agent docs say developers can customize the agent by specifying the LLM provider and model, which directly supports bringing your own provider. The evidence is a single thin mention scoped to the agent feature. It does not show which providers are supported or whether act/extract/observe are also model-agnostic. Missing for 10: list of supported LLM providers, evidence that provider choice applies across act/extract/observe (not just agent), custom/self-hosted model configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bring my own LLM provider — the framework is model-agnostic rather than locked to one vendor's models

citations.quote: You can customize the agent by specifying the LLM provider and model
